description: Deterministic response policy. Rules are evaluated in order and the first match wins; if nothing matches, `fallback` applies. Every finding type named here was confirmed verbatim against the GuardDuty finding-type documentation - do not add a type without checking its spelling there.

containmentActions.evidence: Preserve the finding, instance metadata, snapshots and protection flags.
containmentActions.network: Per-incident quarantine security group applied to every ENI.
containmentActions.credentials: Deny the instance role's credentials via an ec2:SourceInstanceARN condition.
containmentActions.imds: Disable the instance metadata endpoint. Always last - it also cuts off the SSM agent.

actionOrderNote: The order of containment actions is fixed by the state machine (evidence -> network -> credentials -> imds), not by the order of the `actions` list. The list is a set of enabled actions.

rules.description: Types where the finding itself is strong evidence of an active compromise: command and control, cryptocurrency mining, DNS exfiltration and runtime reverse shells. Contained in every environment.

Instance role credentials in use from outside the instance. NOTE: these findings carry resourceType AccessKey, not Instance, so they only reach the pipeline through the AccessKey EventBridge rule added in Phase 3. Until then this rule is unreachable and a test asserts that.

Extended Threat Detection attack sequences are always critical severity. Phase 5 caps how many instances a single sequence may contain automatically (MaxAutoContainInstances); above the cap the sequence goes to approval instead.
Cost harvesting burns real money, so it warrants a human decision rather than a notification.
Remaining GuardDuty AI Protection findings notify by default.

The instance is the TARGET of probing from the internet, not the actor. Anyone on the internet can trigger Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort against an open port, so containing on it would hand an outsider a denial-of-service button. The same types with resourceRole ACTOR mean the instance is doing the scanning and deliberately fall through to the defaults below.
Low severity means attempted but unsuccessful activity. Notify, never contain.
Every remaining identity action needs a human. Disabling the wrong key or denying the wrong role breaks production instantly and is not self-healing.
Outside production, medium severity and above is contained automatically - the blast radius of a wrong call is a developer environment.
In production, anything not on the high-confidence allowlist waits for a human.

fallback.description: Nothing matched. Notify a human rather than guess.
